info.name: AqarCom API (عقاركم)
info.description:
Full end-to-end collection for the AqarCom backend (server/src/routes). Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner or Newman — every request has tests and saves the IDs/tokens the next requests need.

Before running: MongoDB up, `npm run seed` (or create an admin), `npm run dev`. Set the Postman working directory to the `postman/` folder so the files in `fixtures/` are found.

item.name: 00 · Setup & Health

request.description: Needs an existing admin. Run `npm run seed` (admin@aqarcom.app / Passw0rd!) or `npm run create-admin -- <email> <password>` and set adminEmail/adminPassword.

item.description: Run this folder first. It sets a unique runId used to build fresh e-mails every run.

item.name: Forgot password (code printed in server console in dev)

request.description: To test the success path manually: copy the 6-digit code from the server console after 'Forgot password' and put it in `code`.
Field names: engineers_syndicate, commercial_register, other (PDF/JPG/PNG, ≤10 MB). File path is relative to the Postman working directory (the postman/ folder).
